node.title: L1 cofactor-depth budget cancellation and sparse-image fence
node.statement: For an exact shell with w=a-k and forced cofactor degree 0<=e<k, fixed-cofactor transport gives |E_a(U)|<=q^e B_(a,w+e), where B is the largest full split-locator prefix fiber. Hence an ambient-normalized depth-(w+e) bound cancels q^e exactly and returns the natural depth-w scale. Under image normalization the exact residual factor is q^(w+e)/L_(a,w+e), and integer ceilings contribute less than q^e. At the deployed rows the deeper ambient mean first becomes subunit, and the raw possible-cofactor union first exceeds the row budget, at e=2 for KoalaBear and e=1 for Mersenne-31. This is a route fence, not a counterexample: the follow-on Pade normal form identifies the collective target as a graph, while depth-uniform Q, divisor/graph transversality, and e>=k remain open.
